Health & Wellbeing

Work undertaken

Care begins with people.

Health challenges can become harder when resources, awareness or access are limited. Aashray for Health & Wellbeing reflects our commitment to community care and builds on health-related work already undertaken.

01 / Health & Wellbeing

Our experience

Health and wellbeing form part of Aashray’s ground work. Our activity archive will bring together the details, dates and photographs that help explain this work responsibly.

02 / Health & Wellbeing

The direction ahead

We aim to explore community wellbeing, health awareness and appropriate support through partnerships and locally relevant initiatives. Individual programs will be announced with their scope and delivery details when confirmed.

03 / Health & Wellbeing

Work with us

Health professionals, institutions and volunteers can discuss how their expertise may contribute to future initiatives. We welcome conversations about responsible, practical ways to support community wellbeing.
